paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya bar Rava (without further specification).
In Chullin 50a, Rava boasted of him, saying, “My son is expert in the laws of terefot, like Rabbi Yochanan.” Otzar Yisrael cites Kiddushin 33a; Hyman says this is an error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The mistaken Kiddushin citation is Hyman’s judgment about Otzar Yisrael.

Chullin 50a explicitly names Rav Mesharshiya as Rava’s son and gives Rava’s praise, including the full title Rabbi Yochanan. The assertion that Otzar Yisrael’s Kiddushin 33a citation is mistaken remains Hyman’s judgment; the relevant Otzar Yisrael notice has not been directly collated here.
